documentation.content: A summary stream ended with a terminal exception or timeout. Inspect the filing-scoped log and related request. This catches logged failures, not every handled fallback. See docs/OPERATIONS.md.

conditionMatchedLog.filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="earningsnerd-backend" AND ((severity>=ERROR AND (jsonPayload.message:"Error in streaming summary" OR textPayload:"Error in streaming summary")) OR (severity>=WARNING AND (jsonPayload.message:"Pipeline timeout after" OR textPayload:"Pipeline timeout after")))
